findings.title: GuardDuty is not enabled
findings.description: Amazon GuardDuty is not enabled in cn-north-1.
findings.impact: No continuous threat detection for account compromise, instance compromise, or reconnaissance.
remediationSteps: Enable GuardDuty in the AWS console or via API.
GuardDuty offers a 30-day free trial.

findings.title: Inspector is not enabled
findings.description: Amazon Inspector is not enabled in cn-north-1.
findings.impact: No automated vulnerability scanning for EC2 instances, Lambda functions, or container images.
remediationSteps: Enable Inspector in the AWS console.
Inspector offers a 15-day free trial.

findings.title: Hardcoded AWS access key found in Lambda environment variables
findings.description: Lambda function data-processor-fn has AWS access key ID (AKIA...) stored as plaintext in environment variables.
findings.impact: Exposed credentials can be used for unauthorized access to AWS resources. Keys may be leaked via CloudWatch logs.
remediationSteps: Remove hardcoded credentials from environment variables.
Use an IAM execution role with appropriate permissions instead.
Rotate the exposed access key immediately.

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0abc123 has SSH (22) reachable from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.description: Instance i-0abc123 has SSH port 22 reachable from the internet via SG + NACL analysis.
findings.impact: SSH exposed to the internet increases brute-force and credential stuffing risk.
remediationSteps: Restrict port 22 to known IP ranges.
Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of SSH.

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0xyz789 has RDP (3389) reachable from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.description: Instance i-0xyz789 has RDP port 3389 reachable from the internet via security group sg-0aabb11.
findings.impact: RDP exposed to the internet enables remote desktop brute-force attacks.
remediationSteps: Restrict port 3389 to known IP ranges or VPN CIDR.
Use AWS Systems Manager Fleet Manager for remote desktop access.

findings.title: IAM user admin-user can escalate privileges via iam:CreatePolicyVersion
findings.description: User admin-user has iam:CreatePolicyVersion permission which allows creating a new policy version with full admin access.
findings.impact: Privilege escalation to full administrator access.
remediationSteps: Remove iam:CreatePolicyVersion from the user's permissions.
Use AWS Organizations SCPs to prevent privilege escalation.

findings.title: IAM role data-pipeline-role has overly permissive sts:AssumeRole trust policy
findings.description: Role data-pipeline-role trust policy allows sts:AssumeRole from any principal in account 468254682119 without conditions.
findings.impact: Any IAM entity in the account can assume this role, potentially gaining unintended permissions.
remediationSteps: Restrict the trust policy to specific principals.
Add conditions such as aws:PrincipalTag or aws:SourceIp.

findings.title: S3 bucket data-exports-bucket has public ACL grants
findings.description: S3 bucket data-exports-bucket has ACL grants allowing public read access (AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers).
findings.impact: Sensitive data in the bucket may be publicly accessible.
remediationSteps: Remove public ACL grants from the bucket.
Enable S3 Block Public Access at the bucket level.
Review bucket contents for sensitive data exposure.

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0def456 missing required tag: Environment
findings.description: Instance i-0def456 is missing the required 'Environment' tag.
findings.impact: Cannot determine resource environment for cost allocation and access control.
remediationSteps: Add the 'Environment' tag with an appropriate value (e.g., production, staging, dev).

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0def456 missing required tag: Project
findings.description: Instance i-0def456 is missing the required 'Project' tag.
findings.impact: Cannot determine project ownership for cost allocation.
remediationSteps: Add the 'Project' tag with the appropriate project name.

findings.title: EC2 instance i-0def456 missing required tag: Owner
findings.description: Instance i-0def456 is missing the required 'Owner' tag.
findings.impact: Cannot determine resource ownership.
remediationSteps: Add the 'Owner' tag with the responsible team or individual.

findings.title: Unattached EBS volume vol-0aaa111
findings.description: EBS volume vol-0aaa111 (100GB, gp3) is not attached to any instance.
findings.impact: Unused volume incurs storage costs and may contain stale data.
remediationSteps: Snapshot the volume if data is needed, then delete it.
Attach it to an instance if still required.

findings.title: Unused Elastic IP 1.2.3.4
findings.description: Elastic IP 1.2.3.4 is not associated with any instance or network interface.
findings.impact: Unused EIPs incur hourly charges.
remediationSteps: Release the Elastic IP if no longer needed.

findings.title: RDS instance mydb-prod does not have Multi-AZ enabled
findings.description: RDS instance mydb-prod is not configured for Multi-AZ deployment.
findings.impact: Single point of failure — an AZ outage will cause database downtime.
remediationSteps: Enable Multi-AZ for the RDS instance.
This provides automatic failover to a standby in a different AZ.

findings.title: S3 bucket app-assets has no cross-region replication configured
findings.description: S3 bucket app-assets does not have cross-region replication (CRR) enabled.
findings.impact: Data loss risk in a regional disaster — no offsite backup for bucket contents.
remediationSteps: Enable cross-region replication to cn-northwest-1.
Ensure versioning is enabled on both source and destination buckets.

findings.title: [Security Hub] S3.8 — S3 Block Public Access setting should be enabled at the bucket level
findings.description: FSBP control S3.8: S3 Block Public Access not enabled at bucket level.
findings.impact: Bucket may be publicly accessible.
remediationSteps: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the bucket level.

findings.title: [Security Hub] EC2.2 — VPC default security group should not allow inbound or outbound traffic
findings.description: FSBP control EC2.2: Default VPC security group allows traffic.
findings.impact: Resources using the default security group may have unintended network access.
remediationSteps: Remove all inbound and outbound rules from the default security group.

findings.title: [Security Hub] IAM.4 — IAM root user access key should not exist
findings.description: FSBP control IAM.4: Root user has active access keys. MFA status not verified.
findings.impact: Root account compromise gives unrestricted access to all AWS services and resources.
remediationSteps: Delete root user access keys.
Enable MFA on the root account.
Use IAM users or roles for daily operations.

findings.title: [Security Hub] CloudTrail is not enabled in all regions
findings.description: AWS Config rule: CloudTrail is configured for cn-north-1 only, not all regions.
findings.impact: API activity in other regions will not be logged, reducing audit visibility.
remediationSteps: Update CloudTrail to enable multi-region logging.
Enable log file validation for tamper detection.

findings.title: [Security Hub] S3 bucket versioning is not enabled
findings.description: AWS Config rule: S3 bucket logs-archive-bucket does not have versioning enabled.
findings.impact: Accidental or malicious deletion of objects cannot be recovered.
remediationSteps: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket.
Consider adding lifecycle rules to manage version retention.

findings.title: [Security Hub] CVE-2024-6387 — OpenSSH regresshion vulnerability on i-0abc123
findings.description: Inspector finding: EC2 instance i-0abc123 running OpenSSH 8.5p1 affected by CVE-2024-6387 (regresshion).
findings.impact: Remote code execution via race condition in signal handler. CVSS 8.1.
remediationSteps: Update OpenSSH to version 9.8p1 or later.
As a workaround, set LoginGraceTime to 0 in sshd_config (may cause DoS).

findings.title: [Security Hub] S3 bucket allows cross-account access from external account
findings.description: Access Analyzer finding: S3 bucket shared-data-bucket policy grants access to external account 123456789012.
findings.impact: Data in the bucket is accessible to an external AWS account, which may be unintended.
remediationSteps: Review the bucket policy and remove unintended cross-account grants.
Use S3 Access Points for controlled cross-account access.

findings.title: [Security Hub] Unusual API call pattern detected from EC2 instance
findings.description: GuardDuty finding: EC2 instance i-0xyz789 made unusual DescribeInstances and GetCallerIdentity API calls at 03:00 UTC.
findings.impact: Potential reconnaissance activity indicating compromised instance credentials.
remediationSteps: Investigate the instance for unauthorized access.
Rotate instance role credentials.
Review CloudTrail logs for the full API call timeline.

findings.title: VPC limit approaching: 4 of 5 VPCs in use
findings.description: Trusted Advisor check: 4 of 5 VPCs are in use (80% utilization) in cn-north-1.
findings.impact: Approaching the VPC limit may prevent creation of new VPCs when needed.
remediationSteps: Request a VPC limit increase via AWS Support.
Review existing VPCs and delete unused ones.
